repairs.quote: Begin Charging: Zac pulls himself taut, charging up a dash over 0.9/1/1.1/1.2/1.3 seconds. Release: Zac launches himself and Knocks Up enemies where he lands for up to 1 second (based on charge time), dealing them (60/105/150/195/240 + (80% Ability Power)) magic damage. Zac spawns an extra chunk of Goo for each enemy champion hit. Can be cancelled by moving. If cancelled, refunds half of the Ability's Cooldown and cost.
